title: The draft-pr guard lets a Write whose text names a PR create
why: The draft-pr guard (record draft-until-reviewed) refused a Write of a test fixture whose text held the PR-create command words (coordinator, 16:50 CST Nov 7). A guard that cries wolf is spent.
